calculation_rule: Balancing figure to reach monthly fixed gross
Hours x (monthly fixed gross / 208) x 2.0; cap 50 hours; eligible roles only
Performance bonus (April), sales incentive (quarter-end), festival bonus, spot award
0.75% of gross if monthly fixed gross <= 21,000
Projected annual tax / 12 + marginal tax on variable pay
Fixed EMI as per employee advance
3.25% of gross if monthly fixed gross <= 21,000
